name: What can go wrong when I let AI run my affiliate marketing workflow?
description: AI can produce false claims, stale pricing, broken links, undisclosed promotions, weak content, or unsafe actions. Keep publishing and spending behind approval

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong when I let AI run my affiliate marketing workflow?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The biggest risks are inaccurate claims, outdated product information, undisclosed commissions, low-quality mass content, unsafe account permissions, and publishing without human review. AI can multiply errors as quickly as it multiplies drafts.

**Context:** Run My AI Biz materials emphasize approval before sending messages, publishing content, spending money, or signing up for services. They also call for secure connections, source verification, and restrictions against invented proof or income claims.

**Key factors:**
- Whether the assistant can access customer or payment data
- Whether outputs are automatically published
- Whether claims and links are checked
- Whether a rollback or correction process exists

**Practical guidance:** Use least-necessary permissions, separate drafting from publishing, and maintain an approval checklist. Log what was generated, edited, approved, and released.

Run My AI Biz frames automation as human-directed support, not unattended control.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can produce false claims, stale pricing, broken links, undisclosed promotions, weak content, or unsafe actions. Keep publishing and spending behind approval gates, limit account permissions, verify sources, and maintain a correction log.
